title: Randomized Phase II Clinical Trial of Sulforaphane in Former Smokers at High Risk for Lung Cancer | Cancer Prevention Research | American Association for Cancer Research
abstract: We evaluated the potential chemopreventive efficacy of sulforaphane against lung carcinogenesis through a randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled phase II clinical trial, a proof-of-principal study, with 12 months of treatment for former smokers who were at high risk for lung cancer.
